notes.title: Warning: Lunar Assault!
notes.content:
Hello Captains! Since the launch of "Critical Point," we've received extensive feedback and suggestions from players while gradually realizing our vision for the game.
After months of development, we're excited to roll out this update! Here are the details:

[h2]New Starship:[/h2]
[quote]"Hey, look at the sky! Why is the moon drifting away?"
"I knew it! Humanity would never prepare just one ark—the 'Devourer'!"
[/quote]
This update introduces a new starship transformed from the Moon. Human civilization will journey to a new home aboard Earth's oldest companion.
The new starship features a primal skill that will reshape your early-game experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482894/24a26cbcd74dd94593b48475191660006cdfeb84.gif[/img]

[h2]Revamped UI:[/h2]
[quote]"3…2…1… System upgrade complete."
"Good to see you again, Captain."
[/quote]
We've overhauled all in-game UI interfaces to enhance sci-fi immersion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482894/b9ca1832e5a87d73b600709e3feaea5b4e214465.gif[/img]

[h2]New Plugins:[/h2]
[quote]"R&D has achieved a breakthrough."
[/quote]
New plugins have been added. Unlock and utilize them in-game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482894/e039528dd38b3b02137a6dfaccbc1e29d6b28d40.gif[/img]

Optimizations:
[quote]"The path to humanity's new home is ever-changing."
[/quote]
Based on community feedback, we've rebalanced game stats, merged event systems with phase-end mechanics, and adjusted modules prone to creating "perpetual motion" loops.

Only 3 days left until the launch discount ends—don't miss out!

notes.title: "Critical Point" v1.0.1 update is here!
notes.content:
Hello, Captains!
Take half an hour for a thrilling and intense brain battle!
"Critical Point" has received its first update since launch:


[list]
[*] Enhanced the effects of some plugins
[*] Improved the result/settlement screen
[*] Optimized the difficulty curve within levels — the game is now more challenging
[/list]
We hope this brings you a unique journey through the stars!

notes.title: Critical Point Launches on Steam This April Fools' Day!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are the two-person indie game studio—[b]Boxwood Studio[/b], currently focused on developing strategy genre indie games.

Though the game launched on April Fools' Day, we’re dead serious!

Critical Point is a retro sci-fi casual strategy game, refined from a Game Jam prototype. We hope to escape reality’s chaos with space-loving players and embark on an interstellar journey.

The game is now live on Steam! Priced at [b]$2.49[/b], with a launch discount 10% for the first two weeks! 
If you have feedback or want to join future update tests, please join our Discord Channel!
We’re also developing another strategy game— [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169910/]Weapons Arena[/url], launching this year. Wishlist it now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482894/8c9d4b09a1f2cda739f94ca224d57f5c3c2ae979.jpg[/img]

[h3]Upcoming updates for Critical Point:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New spacecraft
[*] Additional plugins
[*] Increased difficulty
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Endless Mode and leaderboards
[/list]

We’ll keep fixing bugs and improving your experience!
Report issues via our community links below~!
